notes.sourceText: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
notes.findingJa: Canaanites住民集団初出。索引のCanaan初出3:3は欠落、1:1へ修正依頼。

notes.sourceText: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
notes.findingJa: Hebron=KiriathArbaの旧名が明示。三人の名は同節から。

notes.sourceText: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
notes.findingJa: Debir=KiriathSepher旧名が明示。

notes.sourceText: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
notes.findingJa: Zephath→Hormah命名関係。

notes.sourceText: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
notes.findingJa: Jebusites住民群、Jebus地名とは区別。既存person ID追加承認。

notes.sourceText: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
notes.findingJa: Luz=Bethel旧名。1:26Hittites地の新Luzは別町、同一地図へまとめない。

notes.sourceText: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
notes.findingJa: Amorites集団初出。既存person ID追加承認。

notes.sourceText: The LORD’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.
notes.findingJa: LORDのangelは固有名のある天使を同定しない。

notes.sourceText: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals.
notes.findingJa: Baal複数形は2:13単数形より早い。宗教称号の意味を区別。

notes.sourceText: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
notes.findingJa: LORD’sSpiritの初出、evilspirit9:23とは別。

notes.sourceText: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
notes.findingJa: cityofpalmtreesは名称未明記、後代Jericho同定は推論と明示が必要。

notes.sourceText: The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
notes.findingJa: JabinはJOS同名王との同一性を断定しない。

notes.sourceText: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
notes.findingJa: Jael初出はHeber妻/避難先の幕屋。殺害結末は4:21。

notes.sourceText: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
notes.findingJa: Amalek/Machir等は詩的地域・集団文脈で祖先個人の伝記へ短絡しない。

notes.sourceText: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.
notes.findingJa: JoashAbiezrite初出からAbiezer氏族を採否確認、6:34より早い。

notes.sourceText: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”
notes.findingJa: GideonにJerubbaal命名。7:1明示関係も参照、初出6:11へ先取りしない。

notes.sourceText: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.
notes.findingJa: MountGileadは北西の特異地理表現、一般Gilead領域の点へ昇格しない。

notes.sourceText: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
notes.findingJa: Abimelech初名・側女の子。王号即位9:6と死9:54を先取りしない。

notes.sourceText: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
notes.findingJa: evilspiritはLORD’sSpiritのカードへ接続しない。

notes.sourceText: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?
notes.findingJa: Hamor父Shechemの個人名とShechem都市/住民政治主体を区別。

notes.sourceText: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.
notes.findingJa: Jephthah父Gilead=1318、Machir系祖先1317と別。11:2誤索引を1318へ移管承認。

notes.sourceText: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”
notes.findingJa: Ammon王の領土主張を原典の客観的確定境界と混同しない。

notes.sourceText: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever the LORD our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.
notes.findingJa: Chemoshについて相手の神という発話以上の個体/民族宗教を断定しない。

notes.sourceText: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel
notes.findingJa: Jephthah娘の誓願の実行について解釈を本文叙述に付加しない。

notes.sourceText: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
notes.findingJa: IbzanのBethlehemは本文だけでJudah/Zebulunのいずれかを確定しない。

notes.sourceText: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
notes.findingJa: Abdon初出はHillel子/士師。八年は12:14へゲート。

notes.sourceText: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
notes.findingJa: Manoah初出は子なし夫婦、Samson父の名前対応は13:24まで先取りしない。

notes.sourceText: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
notes.findingJa: Samson本人初名。胎児予告を将来名で遡及表示しない。

notes.sourceText: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
notes.findingJa: Delilah初出はSorek女性/愛した対象、民族や配偶者であることは明記なし。

notes.sourceText: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that the LORD had departed from him.
notes.findingJa: 毛髪と力とLORDの離去を俗説的説明に単純化せず節ごとにゲート。

notes.sourceText: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.
notes.findingJa: Leviteは無名。18:30Jonathanの名をここに先取りしない。

notes.sourceText: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
notes.findingJa: Laish→Dan命名、Dan祖先とIsrael個人父とDanite集団を同節内で区別。

notes.sourceText: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.
notes.findingJa: 固定WEB Jonathan/Gershom/Moses。KJVManasseh由来候補との差を保持。

notes.sourceText: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.
notes.findingJa: Jebus=Jerusalem明示、住民Jebusitesと別。

notes.sourceText: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” The LORD said, “Judah first.”
notes.findingJa: 固定WEBBethel、KJVhouseofGod表現差が地名索引へ影響し得る。

notes.sourceText: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”
notes.findingJa: Shiloh地理はBethel北/Shechem街道東/Lebonah南、現代精密点の独立検証ではない。
